description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: ai-ml

facts.claim: AI: machines doing tasks associated with human intelligence

source.quote: is the capability of computational systems to perform tasks typically associated with human intelligence

facts.claim: Goals include learning, reasoning, planning and perception

source.quote: The traditional goals of AI research include learning, reasoning, knowledge representation, planning

facts.claim: An agent perceives through sensors and acts through actuators

source.quote: an agent is anything that perceives its environment through sensors and acts upon that environment through actuators

facts.claim: It acts to achieve goals

source.quote: takes actions autonomously to achieve goals

facts.claim: A* uses a heuristic to guide search

source.quote: A* achieves better performance by using heuristics to guide its search

facts.claim: A* is a best-first search for least-cost paths

source.quote: A* is an informed search algorithm, or a best-first search

facts.claim: Minimax minimises the possible loss in the worst case

source.quote: for minimizing t

facts.claim: Maximin: maximise the minimum gain

source.quote: to maximize the minimum gain

facts.claim: ML algorithms learn from data and generalise to unseen data

source.quote: statistical algorithms that can learn from data and generalize to unseen

facts.claim: Overfitting fits training data too closely and fails on new data

source.quote: corresponds too closely or exactly to a particular set of data

facts.claim: Judge a model by performance on unseen data

source.quote: its ability to perform well on unseen data

facts.claim: Models the relationship between a response and explanatory variables

source.quote: estimates the relationship between a scalar response (dependent variable) and one or more explanatory variables

facts.claim: One explanatory variable = simple linear regression

source.quote: A linear model with exactly one explanatory variable is a simple linear regression

facts.claim: Models the log-odds as a linear combination of inputs

source.quote: models the log-odds of an event as a linear combination of one or more independent variables

facts.claim: Binary outcome coded 0 and 1

source.quote: In binary logistic regression there is a single binary dependent variable

facts.claim: A tree is built by splitting the data into subsets

source.quote: A tree is built by splitting the source set, constituting the root node of the tree, into subsets

facts.claim: Decision tree learning is supervised

source.quote: Decision tree learning is a supervised learning approach

facts.claim: Partition n observations into k clusters by nearest mean

source.quote: aims to partition n observations into k clusters in which each observation belongs to the c

facts.claim: Step opposite to the gradient (steepest descent)

source.quote: take repeated steps in the opposite direction of the gradient

facts.claim: Step size is the learning rate
